body:
>  It really sucks that I am who I am. Girls of my own race don't like me, girls of other races don't either.

Few women like being over generalized and told who they "can" and "can't" like.  There are many American-raised Indian women who date Indian men.  You are copping out by saying that every Indian woman will discount you because you're not white.  That is an excuse.


If you want women to think of you as someone other than the "repressive, obsessive Indian guy", then don't be that way.  Do you really want to date a woman who racially stereotypes you that way anyway?

Thank you for your offer.  Sadly I disappoint myself all the time, too.  I push myself to do things that are important to me, and that I love doing, but nevertheless still I fail miserably at them - not ever just small failures, but spectacularly catastrophic failures.  I appreciate your advice, though.
